message.content: During the community garden renovation discussions, Li Hua suggested including lavender and coneflowers in the flower beds. She specifically mentioned that these flowers would be beneficial because they are "beautiful and great for pollinators." Additionally, she noted that they do not require too much maintenance. However, the feedback did not specify any additional new species of flowers that will be featured beyond the lavender and coneflowers. Therefore, based on the information provided, the new species of flowers to be featured in the community garden renovation are lavender and coneflowers.
